checks.name: Actual complete three-phase tiny receipt is mandatory with no arbitrary boolean override
Borrowed density/profile/original-double buffers are synchronously deep-copied with exact valid prefixes
Pair/constructor/numeric input gates reject before a field can be allocated
Independent oracle is bounded to16 deterministic source rows and retains every density packet

evidence.scope: CPU oracle execution only; no shader, draw or GPU query

checks.name: Invalid lock/receipt/token calls draw nothing, retain no session, and reset the reentrancy guard
Bounded phases use supported target metadata and explicit prefix readback without new context/canvas/scene updates

limits: Pure data copy/oracle/gate and static helper review only; no GL context, field allocation, timer, readback or GPU draw.
Root must perform separate explicit warmup/pair on its existing healthy renderer after current-context tiny receipts.
